content.title: Blackstone (NYSE:BX) Price Target Lowered to $131.00 at HSBC
content.text: Blackstone (NYSE:BX - Get Free Report) had its target price lowered by equities researchers at HSBC from $164.00 to $131.00 in a research note issued to investors on Friday,MarketScreener reports. The brokerage currently has a "hold" rating on the asset manager's stock. HSBC's price target indicates a potential upside of 11.90% from the stock's previous close.This ETF Caught a Major Tailwind After the Fed’s Rate CutA number of other equities research analysts have also issued reports on BX. Citigroup reissued a "market outperform" rating on shares of Blackstone in a research report on Friday, January 30th. UBS Group reduced their price objective on shares of Blackstone from $171.00 to $137.00 and set a "neutral" rating for the company in a research note on Friday, February 20th. Argus reduced their price target on Blackstone from $195.00 to $163.00 and set a "buy" rating for the company in a research report on Wednesday, February 4th. Weiss Ratings reissued a "hold (c)" rating on shares of Blackstone in a research note on Wednesday, January 21st. Finally, Citizens Jmp reiterated a "market outperform" rating and issued a $195.00 price target on shares of Blackstone in a research note on Friday, January 30th. Ten equities research analysts have rated the stock with a Buy rating and eleven have issued a Hold rating to the company's stock. According to MarketBeat.com, the company has a consensus rating of "Hold" and an average price target of $155.33.Check Out Our Latest Research Report on BlackstoneBlackstone Price PerformanceHidden Gems: 3 Quiet Stocks With Loud PotentialNYSE BX opened at $117.07 on Friday. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.61, a quick ratio of 0.76 and a current ratio of 0.76. The stock has a 50-day simple moving average of $118.30 and a 200 day simple moving average of $142.06. Blackstone has a twelve month low of $101.73 and a twelve month high of $190.09. The stock has a market capitalization of $86.88 billion, a PE ratio of 30.17, a P/E/G ratio of 1.18 and a beta of 1.74. Blackstone (NYSE:BX - Get Free Report) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, January 29th. The asset manager reported $1.75 earnings per share for the quarter, beating analysts' consensus estimates of $1.54 by $0.21. The firm had revenue of $4.36 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $3.69 billion. Blackstone had a net margin of 20.89% and a return on equity of 22.17%. The business's revenue was up 41.4% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter in the previous year, the firm posted $1.69 earnings per share. Research analysts anticipate that Blackstone will post 5.87 EPS for the current year.
